anomalies.description: A man is shown aiming and firing a handgun; muzzle flash and water droplets are visible, indicating discharge in a wet environment.
A man is forcibly pushed or thrown backward into a pool of water by an unseen assailant, suggesting an attack on a vulnerable individual.
The act of throwing the man into water appears to be part of a physical confrontation, with one party actively subduing another in close proximity.
A person is forcibly submerged into water in a dark, confined space; the sequence shows violent splashing and submersion consistent with drowning or forced immersion.

Initial physical struggle occurs as the victim is pushed or thrown into the water, evidenced by chaotic motion and large splash at impact (frames f2–f4), indicating mutual or one-sided combat preceding submersion.

A person is submerged and struggling in turbulent, dark water in a sewer-like environment; their body is partially visible and appears helpless while being tossed by the current, suggesting they are being subjected to drowning or forced submersion.

A man in tactical gear enters the scene, advances toward the water, and performs aggressive, combative gestures (arms raised, stance wide, apparent shouting) while facing the submerged individual, indicating active physical confrontation or imminent assault.

The submerged person is shown with head fully underwater, face down, in a posture consistent with forced submersion or drowning, while the armed individual remains nearby—indicating continued abuse of a helpless victim.
